source_review: Hadoop 3.4.3 TestDFSStartupVersions.testVersions loops over deliberately valid and invalid DataNode VERSION states and checks whether each startup outcome matches the compatibility rule. This exact BlockPoolSliceStorage guard compares a stored field with NameNode NamespaceInfo. Two healthy actor-bound seeds reached it; 80 strictly injected same-actor postfault checks produced no exception at this target. Its simple storage-version comparison does not establish a multi-hop ad hoc coordination chain, and no new bug was observed at this guard in the base budget.
